collection_method: The hidden checker always emits the full leaf list: 29 self-contained adapter scenarios plus the verifier-owned offline no-default-features gate, so a candidate build failure, panic, hang, or protocol violation fails leaves rather than shrinking the denominator.
excluded_from_denominator: ambient-random and wall-clock behaviour (new_v4/now_v7/Timestamp::now/RNG contexts): unbounded nondeterminism cannot be pinned to a frozen expectation
version 3 (MD5) generation: its md-5 dependency tree is outside the two-package offline closure
optional serde/borsh/slog/arbitrary/bytemuck/zerocopy/wasm integrations: undeclared dependencies and out-of-contract features
Timestamp::to_unix_nanos: panics at this revision as a deprecated stub, so it is documented as out of contract rather than asserted
the deprecated rfc4122 Builder aliases and the Error/ErrorKind Debug representation (internal names are not a public guarantee)
